reason: Schedule/feasibility lens: as described (lab-gated on friend A's x138 cache, both FULL tails run in the kernel), P(honestly gated scored probe before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC) ~0.25-0.3, well under 0.70. Cited numbers check out (DIFF.md s.4 121,777/114,927; CONTEXT l.1431 flow/readmit/gapfill neutral alone; #29 0.947/#30 0.946; swapfix -0.00004; forum 739685 linker ~+0.001 LB). The critical path breaks on these points. (1) The lab dependency does not exist yet and is conditional twice. PROMPT_FRIEND_A.md top block (25 Sep 08:30 UTC) says the x138 cache has NOT started and starts only if #34 == 0.953 (scores 17-20 UTC 25 Sep). Friend A has made no commits since 24 Sep (CONTEXT resume block), his PC rebooted, and an earlier Windows port of a foreign stack was abandoned after >1 working day (B34, PROMPT_FRIEND_A l.274). The x138 cache is a new port of a new stack (tracksdata ILP, 2 seeds x 8-view TTA, V1284 head) on Windows, not a rerun of runner.py. (2) The x138 tail is NOT image-free (exp56 cell 5). fill_gaps_from_low_detections and refine_synthetic_midpoint read frames, DeepCenter 0.25 runs the detector on frames (l.408-501), and readmit/gapfill need the low-detection pool dump. Every tail replay therefore needs the full 82 GB data + GPU, i.e. friend A's PC. It cannot run in this container or on friend C's Mac, and the existing replay.py covers only the exp39 stack, so a new x138 replay harness is also needed. (3) Runtime conflict. REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = 27000 s (cell 5 l.19). Sibling runtime-guard verdicts put x138's hidden-test runtime at ~6.5-7.3 h (hidden test ~100-130 videos, CONTEXT l.14). The idea itself says a second tail 'roughly doubles repair seconds', so the guard would fire and degrade the last movies (relink, gapfill, safe divisions and linefit off: ~-0.05 per unit of degraded weight). That makes the probe depend on the unbuilt budget-aware-deadline patch, and raising the deadline adds 12 h-timeout exposure. The 4-video dummy run (train copies) cannot reveal hidden runtime. (4) The build tool does not support it: tools/build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 allows only divinsert|leafprune, so this is a new patch. Porting 'our tail' in full means DivNet veto + DaughterNet with their weights datasets. Arithmetic of the gated path: P(#34 confirms) ~0.85 x P(friend A delivers a working x138 cache by ~27 Sep 12:00 UTC) ~0.4 x P(new harness + 3 tail runs on 199 videos done by ~27 Sep 20:00) ~0.75 x P(scoring lands before 29 Sep 10:00 given submission ~28 Sep 00-06 UTC) ~0.95 = ~0.24. Times P(gate passes) ~0.25 (sibling value verdict: voter 3 ~= our relink, so the vote collapses to a flow-prior-off knob), the chance a probe worth submitting exists is ~0.06. The ungated alternative (skip the lab) could be scored by 26-27 Sep, but it breaks the idea's own validation protocol and spends a slot on an expected ~0 change below the 0.003 noise.
fix_if_any: A repaired, schedule-feasible variant that removes friend A from the critical path. (a) Vote on RELINK OUTPUTS ONLY, inside ONE x138 tail: call x138's own motion_relink_edges three times on the same ILP graph and node set (x138 knobs; x138 with FLOW off; our knobs: raw 0.05, tight 5.5/10). The vote runs before readmit. Resolve per-target disagreements by 2:1 majority, then re-solve a Hungarian restricted to the disagreement set so the result stays a valid matching (in-degree 1, no new forks), with a 3-frame residual tie-break. Downstream readmit/gapfill/DeepCenter/safe-div/linefit run once, as in x138. This adds 2 Hungarian passes (no image IO, a few % of repair time), so there is no guard dependency. Log repair_seconds per movie. (b) Validate on Kaggle, not on friend A: a vitaliineibauer GPU kernel runs exp56 on a train subset (e.g. 20 44b6 + 24 6bba videos, ~3.6-7 min/video on T4 -> ~3-5 GPU-h over 2 concurrent sessions, ~3 h wall). It takes the vote and the plain x138 from the same ILP graph and scores both in-kernel with tools/official. Gate: >= +0.002 on BOTH embryos, >= 55% wins among changed videos, node count and forks identical; discount for the in-sample edge-probability term. (c) Ride on a final-candidate slot, not a dedicated probe. If friend A's x138 cache appears anyway, use it as a second confirmation, not as the gate.
realistic_public_gain: -0.002..+0.001, mean ~0 (guess; linker-class change, forum 739685 ~+0.001 at best; below the 0.003 LB noise, so one probe cannot confirm it)
